meta.title: RouteOpt NL
meta.description: Optimize last-mile delivery routes in Monterrey with genetic algorithms and ant colonies.

cmd.title: Command palette
cmd.description: Search for an action and press Enter.

simulate.title: Dynamic simulation
simulate.body: No simulation is running. Load a scenario in the Planner to simulate new orders and real-time re-optimization.

stops.emptyBody: Load the demo scenario, import a CSV or generate random stops to get started.
stops.importFailed: Could not import the CSV. Check the format and try again.

csvErrors.title: The CSV has errors
csvErrors.summary: {count, plural, one {# row could not be read.} other {# rows could not be read.}} Nothing was imported.

fleet.noProblem: Load a scenario to view and edit the fleet.

constraints.noProblem: Load a scenario to edit constraints.

modeHelp.depot: All drivers leave the depot and return to it.
modeHelp.multi_origin: Each driver starts from their own point. With no end point, the route is open.

constraints.title: Constraints

capacity_kg.label: Weight capacity
capacity_kg.help: Each route's load stays within the vehicle's kg.

capacity_m3.label: Volume capacity
capacity_m3.help: Each route's load stays within the vehicle's m³.

time_windows.label: Time windows
time_windows.help: Arriving late is penalized; arriving early means waiting.

max_shift.label: Maximum shift
max_shift.help: Each route fits within the driver's shift.

priorities.label: Priorities
priorities.help: Lateness on high-priority stops weighs 3 times more.

presets.fastestHelp: Prioritizes finishing the last route as early as possible.
presets.cheapestHelp: Prioritizes total cost in fuel, wages and fixed costs.
presets.fewestHelp: Prioritizes using as few drivers as possible.
presets.balancedHelp: Spreads the weight across time, cost and vehicles.
presets.customHelp: Custom weights. Adjust them under Advanced.

export.failed: Could not export the itinerary. Try again.

error.title: The operation could not be completed

causes.solver_unreachable: The optimization server is not responding. This usually happens while it wakes up after being idle.
causes.network: There is no connection to the server.
causes.rate_limited: You made too many requests in a row. Wait a moment.
causes.invalid_request: The problem has data the server does not accept.
causes.stream_closed: The server closed the connection before returning a result.

infeasible.title: The solution does not meet every constraint
infeasible.hint: Add drivers, use vehicles with more capacity or relax a constraint.

generate.title: Generate random stops
generate.description: Creates a synthetic scenario over real Monterrey businesses. The same seed gives the same scenario.

landing.title: Optimize delivery routes with genetic algorithms and ant colonies
landing.subtitle: Plan last-mile delivery in the Monterrey metropolitan area with memetic GA, ACO, the ACO+GA hybrid and NSGA-II on real streets, with time windows, capacity and priorities.

split.title: Split: from tour to routes
split.body: The chromosome is a permutation of stops. Split walks the tour and cuts it into consecutive segments, one per driver, respecting capacity and shift.
split.note: Cuts and vehicle order of the 40-stop demo solution.
split.aria: Stop tour cut into one segment per driver

pheromone.title: Pheromone: reinforcing the best route
pheromone.body: In MMAS only the best ant deposits pheromone. The edges of its route are reinforced and the rest evaporate every iteration, with minimum and maximum bounds to avoid stagnation.
pheromone.note: First 9 stops of demo route 1. Faint edges: 3 nearest neighbors.
pheromone.aria: Stop graph with the edges of the best route reinforced

pareto.title: Pareto front: time versus cost
pareto.body: NSGA-II does not pick a single winner. It returns the solutions that cannot improve one objective without worsening another, and you choose the trade-off.
pareto.note: Conceptual sketch, not to scale. Point size encodes the number of drivers.
pareto.aria: Scatter of solutions with the non-dominated front joined by a step line

compare.title: Compare algorithms
compare.subtitle: Run several algorithms on the same problem, one after another, and compare cost, time, vehicles and convergence.
compare.gapNote: Gap: fitness difference against the best run. The best cell of each column is shown in green.
compare.empty: No results yet. {algorithms} will run one after another on the same problem.
